name: Combobox / Autocomplete
summary: Editable native text input with manual list autocomplete, authored suggestion filtering, distinct highlight and selection state, light dismissal, native form ownership, and synchronized combobox/listbox semantics.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Relative wrapper for the input and listbox.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Native editable text and form-value owner that controls manual list autocomplete while retaining DOM focus.

anatomy.name: option
anatomy.description: Non-interactive listbox option identified by role=option; selection is activated through the focused input or pointer delegation.

anatomy.name: empty
anatomy.description: Optional non-option status message shown when filtering produces no matches.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible listbox state controlled by combobox--open.

states.name: inputHover
states.description: Pointer hover state that preserves the active validation family.

states.name: inputFocus
states.description: Four-pixel zero-offset focus hierarchy on the text input.

states.name: optionHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on an option.

states.name: optionDisabled
states.description: Unavailable suggestion skipped by pointer and keyboard navigation.

states.name: empty
states.description: No-results status shown without adding a selectable option.

states.name: error
states.description: Error validation family independent from open, highlight, selection, and typed value.

states.name: success
states.description: Success validation family independent from open, highlight, selection, and typed value.

states.name: warning
states.description: Warning validation family independent from open, highlight, selection, and typed value.

behavior.name: comboboxSemantics
behavior.description: The input must expose combobox semantics and reference the active listbox option.

behavior.name: listboxSemantics
behavior.description: The popup exposes listbox semantics; non-interactive options expose selected/disabled state and remain outside the page Tab sequence.

behavior.name: filtering
behavior.description: Typing filters available options while preserving text input behavior.

behavior.name: keyboardNavigation
behavior.description: Arrow keys move the active descendant without cycling, Enter selects, and Escape or Tab closes while ordinary text-editing keys remain native.

behavior.name: selectionAndEvents
behavior.description: Selecting an option writes its authored value to the native input, emits input then change, and closes; highlight alone never changes the value.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The popup light-dismisses without replacing arbitrary typed text and leaves focus ownership on the input.

behavior.name: formOwnership
behavior.description: The native text input solely owns name, value, required validity, FormData, events, and form reset; no hidden mirrored value is added.

behavior.name: controlledUncontrolled
behavior.description: Authored value/open state initialize uncontrolled Web behavior; framework adapters may control the same semantic owners and must avoid a second value store.

behavior.name: selectVsCombobox
behavior.description: Use Select for native finite choices; use Combobox when users need typing, filtering, autocomplete, async results, or richer option matching.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible accessible name associated with the native editable input.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation for the current search value.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Hint displayed while the editable value is empty.

properties.name: autocomplete
properties.description: Native text-field autocomplete hint; it does not replace aria-autocomplete for suggestions.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls listbox visibility and the input expanded state.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes the native text input unavailable.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Marks the native text input as required and shows the standardized decorative marker on its composing Field Wrapper label.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id reference for helper or validation feedback.

accessibility: Use Select instead of Combobox when native select behavior is sufficient.
Expose role="combobox", aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant, and aria-autocomplete on the input when using a custom combobox.
Expose role="listbox" on the popup and role="option" on each option.
Keep the highlighted option synchronized with aria-activedescendant.
Support ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Escape, and Tab behavior without overriding standard single-line text editing keys.
Keep highlight distinct from selected or arbitrary typed value and keep every option out of the page Tab sequence.
Preserve visible labels and descriptions from the Input contract.

web.notes: Canonical CSS and components/js/theme.js implement authored-option filtering, IME-safe input, active-descendant navigation, pointer selection, native events/form reset, light dismissal, and ARIA synchronization without fetching data.
